assets.label: hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel
assets.service: diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression

control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on V-4110 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in governing the impoundment, specifically performing dam-safety review and surveillance. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 8 November 2020 a potential incident was recorded on V-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
